title: Imperial AT-AT
description: Although the charming and affable Lando Calrissian seems more than helpful, ordering Cloud City technicians to repair the disabled Millennium Falcon, Princess Leia remains suspicious of his motives, and even Han isn't exactly sure what's going on. C-3PO's curious disappearance (and eventual re-appearance, in pieces) adds to the mystery. On Dagobah, Luke finally tells Master Yoda that he must leave before his lessons have been completed, because Han and Leia are in mortal danger. Even an appeal from Ben Kenobi's Force spirit cannot change the determined boy's mind...
